description: Consolidate multiple Live bird batches into a Target batch. Earliest hatch date across batches is inherited. Supports confirm and idempotency validation.

allowMixedVariety.description: Required set to true if source batches contain varieties different from target

confirm.description: Set to true to commit, false for dry-run preview

finalQuantity.description: Optional final consolidated quantity (defaults to sum of all batches, 1 <= finalQuantity <= sum)

location.description: Optional new location for consolidated batch (defaults to target location)

notes.description: Optional notes to append to target batch

sourceBatchIds.description: Array of source Live bird batch IDs to be merged into target

targetBatchId.description: Target Live bird batch ID receiving the merged birds

name: merge_bird_batches
